_comment: Pre-existing failures that must NOT be attributed to a diff. Checked in so the whole team shares one answer to 'is this mine?'. Keep it SMALL: every entry here is a test nobody is fixing. Remove an entry the moment the underlying bug is fixed.
_scope: Tests only. Architecture violations are deliberately absent: gate.mjs attributes arch:check output by changed file, and onion-architecture/SKILL.md section 5 points at enforcement.md#current-state as the live inventory, warning that a second copy 'would only drift'. Typecheck is likewise attributed by file, not baselined.

known_failing_tests.cause: The test's own writeFileAt helper splits paths on '/' only, so nested fixture directories are never created.
known_failing_tests.verified: 2026-09-16, by stashing all local work and re-running on plain origin/main. The other 95 tests pass.
